summary: The v41 replay reaches an implemented minetn-3 loader, but JS preflight rejects its shopkeeper while lspo_finalize_level fills rooms after level_finalize_topology clears in_mklev. C explicitly calls fill_special_room after that clear, and shknam.c:shkinit creates the shopkeeper with MM_ESHK. The JS caller already marks this path as _specialRoomFill; makemon preflight fails to honor that marker for MM_ESHK.

source.branch: shknam.c:shkinit creates PM_SHOPKEEPER with MM_ESHK while filling a special level after sp_lev.c:lspo_finalize_level has called level_finalize_topology and cleared gi.in_mklev.
callers: sp_lev.c:lspo_finalize_level: calls level_finalize_topology() and then fill_special_room() for each room
shknam.c:stock_room -> shkinit: calls makemon(&mons[PM_SHOPKEEPER], sx, sy, MM_ESHK)
dependencies: mklev.c:level_finalize_topology clears gi.in_mklev before the special-room fill loop; the JS fill_special_room caller passes _specialRoomFill through stock_room and shkinit.

evidence: The authoritative saved queue entry at .cache/latest-saved-combined-queue.json (SHA-256 bfaeeff70f6ec230b5a26c1b99df918a8391aaa0f54a280b71c0c2dcb00a165e), evaluation challenges/evaluations/accepted-2e5a22fcb59f677d8f21f487546440d26850930c-v41.json, and recording challenges/cases/v41/v41-shop-sellobj-minetown3-map.session.json identify 10 remaining screens of 36, 26/36 cursors, 4464/4814 RNG calls, and a stop at step 26: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: unsupported initial-level monster creation: shopkeeper extension outside shkinit. Queue case, manifest corpus digest, recipe and recording hashes, and evaluation provenance were rechecked at accepted game commit 2e5a22fcb59f677d8f21f487546440d26850930c.

The queue annotation says the top-level dat/minetn-3.lua program is reached by wiz_load_splua/load_special, but this source is already ported: js/mines_levels.js:minetn3 implements the program and MINES_LEVEL_LOADERS registers minetn-3; js/mklev.js:ensureSpecialLevelLoaders includes that registry. The missing program/loader diagnosis is stale for the examined tree.

C source order is explicit: sp_lev.c:lspo_finalize_level calls level_finalize_topology() and then fill_special_room() for each room (sp_lev.c:6055-6058). mklev.c:level_finalize_topology sets gi.in_mklev = FALSE before returning. shknam.c:shkinit then calls makemon(&mons[PM_SHOPKEEPER], sx, sy, MM_ESHK) (shknam.c:663-665); makemon.c allocates ESHK for MM_ESHK without an in_mklev restriction (makemon.c:1242).

The JS path preserves the source context: mklev.js:fill_special_room creates normalized env with _specialRoomFill=true before calling stock_room; shknam.js:shkinit passes MM_ESHK and the normalized env to makemon. makemon_create.js:preflightCreation recognizes _specialRoomFill for calls after topology finalization, but shopkeeperCall at the MM_ESHK gate requires state.in_mklev, so the valid post-finalization shopkeeper call is refused.

The minimal source-backed divergence scope is makemon.c:makemon behavior represented by js/makemon_create.js:preflightCreation: admit the exact PM_SHOPKEEPER/MM_ESHK shape when either in_mklev is true or the existing _specialRoomFill caller marker is true. No loader-registry edit is needed; B219 owns that shared contract, but minetn-3 is already registered in the examined tree.
